scripts.//unused-exports: Fails on an export or file nothing imports; every typecheck runs it first (turbo.json). What counts, and each exemption with its reason: knip.jsonc.
scripts.//typecheck-scripts: scripts/ and the root's .mts lint configs belong to no package, so no package's typecheck reaches them; typecheck runs this beside theirs. The lint configs read @agents-inc/lint-rules from its dist, so this waits for its build (turbo.json).
scripts.//report-leftover-stryker-copies: Names each copy of the repo a killed Stryker run left in .stryker-tmp; every package's test waits for it (turbo.json). The flag stops Node 23 warning that type stripping is experimental on every run.
